subject: Missing risk schedule copy
text: A storm cancelled my inbound flight this morning, so the office archive materials are delayed. I have the project summary ready, but the approved risk schedule is still missing from the shared folder. Could you send the current signed copy when convenient? Please use the PDF version rather than a scan, so the approval page remains legible. If the schedule was revised after Tuesday, note the revision date in your reply. I do not need it immediately, but I want it before the late afternoon call. If it has already gone to someone else, tell me who received it. If you cannot locate it, I can chase.
